title: xDrip plus wont open on on Tic Watch Pro
symptom: xDrip+ crashes on a Tic Watch Pro after agreeing to the medical disclaimer, and the app cannot be opened to set up.
cause: The user's mistake was trying to install xDrip through the sideload protocol, which does not work on the watch.
fix: Install the xDrip APK on an Android phone first, then download it from the Play Store on the watch under 'Apps on your watch'.
evidence_quote: i solved this by going to playstore on the watch...scrolling down to apps on watch and dowloading xdrip from there into the watch. worked perfectly. my mistake was trying to install xdrip throigh the sideload protocol. it doesnt work
